command: set -euo pipefail; test "$(id -un)" = ai-core-node; VPID=$(systemctl --user show frankenstein-gespraechsmodus.service -p MainPID --value); CPID=$(systemctl --user show frankenstein-chatgpt-client.service -p MainPID --value); echo VOICE_PID=$VPID; echo CLIENT_PID=$CPID; echo '===VOICE_PROC==='; ps -p "$VPID" -o pid=,ppid=,etimes=,stat=,args= || true; tr '\0' ' ' < "/proc/$VPID/cmdline" 2>/dev/null; echo; echo '===VOICE_CHILDREN==='; pgrep -a -P "$VPID" || true; echo '===VOICE_NET==='; ss -tpn 2>/dev/null | grep -E "pid=$VPID[,)]" || true; echo '===VOICE_AUDIO_FDS==='; for fd in /proc/$VPID/fd/*; do t=$(readlink "$fd" 2>/dev/null || true); case "$t" in /dev/snd/*|*pulse*|*pipewire*) echo "$fd -> $t";; esac; done; echo '===CLIENT_PROC==='; ps -p "$CPID" -o pid=,ppid=,etimes=,stat=,args= || true; tr '\0' ' ' < "/proc/$CPID/cmdline" 2>/dev/null; echo; echo '===CONFIG==='; systemctl --user show frankenstein-gespraechsmodus.service -p ExecStart -p ActiveState -p SubState -p ActiveEnterTimestamp --no-pager; systemctl --user show frankenstein-chatgpt-client.service -p ExecStart -p ActiveState -p SubState -p ActiveEnterTimestamp --no-pager; echo QUIESCENCE_PREFLIGHT_DONE=1
